mobbin:b9954846-af25-412f-856b-74fb74503.summary: From the timer list, the user switches to Pomodoro, names and tags a focus session, and starts through notification prompts. They run including full-screen, reach near-end, then hit the break phase and confirm skipping it.
steps: Focus panel: name and project or tags
steal: When ready, a session label and project or person label sit above a huge dial. Full-width Start session and an expand control open room-visible full-screen.
While running, Stop pauses the clock and underlined End focus session finishes the cycle. Those are two distinct end intents.
Full-screen uses oversized digits plus Stop and Exit full-screen for across-the-room readability.
Break flips colour and label (green Break / Relax!) and asks for confirmation before Skip this break.
avoid: Back-to-back in-app then system notification permission dialogs mid-run interrupt the live session. Ask for permissions before start.
mobbin:b9954846-af25-412f-856b-74fb74503.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile or a propped tablet beats the SRV for in-room phase timers customers buy separately today. Full-screen and phase colours replace dedicated digital timers. Pomodoro work and break labels would map to sim phases, not focus or break slang.

mobbin:110e340a-c8ad-43c7-b46e-1b58981b0.summary: From an empty timer list with a start tip, the list fills with today's entries and restart plays. Then come suggestions plus activity, then multi-day history with favorites and a sticky start bar.
steps: Empty list with Start the timer tip
Multi-day history with favorites start bar
steal: When empty, an illustration and tip pinned to the thumb-zone play button teaches first start.
In the list, each past entry has a one-tap play to restart the same named timer.
Suggestions are hideable quick-restart cards above activity for frequent phases.
A sticky bottom bar with I'm working on and a large play stays available while scrolling history.
avoid: The list alone does not show an active running status or room-visible countdown. Pair it with a dedicated running or fullscreen surface for live sim phases.
mobbin:110e340a-c8ad-43c7-b46e-1b58981b0.fit: Mobile and iPad app: mobile helps faculty and tech juggle multiple named phase timers on the floor (extends separate digital timers). Restart-from-history is the win over desktop for repeating scenario phases.
